title: Add Binary
summary: Add the two nonnegative integers written as binary strings.

contractDetails.constraints: Each input contains 1–10000 bits. Neither input has a leading zero unless it equals 0.
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned str.

statement: Add the two nonnegative integers written as binary strings. Return their sum as a binary string without redundant leading zeros.

examples.explanation: Zero leaves the other input unchanged.
A carry propagates through all four positions.

constraints: Each input contains 1–10000 bits. Neither input has a leading zero unless it equals 0.
hints: Conceptual: The carry moves from lower to higher positions.
Directional: Read both strings from their right ends.
Implementation: Add the two available bits and the carry. Record the remainder modulo two and carry the quotient to the next position.
complexityAnalysis: O(max(a,b)) time and O(max(a,b)) output storage, where a and b denote lengths.
